address: via Circonvallazione 1, Trezzano sul Naviglio, 20090, Italy
bio: Enjoy attentive service from the female owner in this small modern restaurant situated on the outskirts of Milan. The cuisine has an equal focus on meat and fish – our inspector particularly enjoyed the lobster roll with avocado, celeriac and pan brioche, as well as the roasted scallops with lentils, salicornia and creamed potatoes. An interesting and reasonably priced lunch menu is available at midday....
